svg.title: FixMyResume — LLM resume optimizer
svg.desc: Scores a resume against a job description and rewrites the gaps. +35% ATS match in under 5s, served by a JWT-secured Python API that holds 100+ RPM. Built with Django, React, PostgreSQL, Gemini.
